outcome: Distance between IUD and internal os
cohort: 91 women who received a postpartum IUD (60 PVD and 31 PCS)
finding: While a substantial risk of IUD expulsion/removal exists, ultrasound examination after insertion to measure the distance between the IUD and internal os can reasonably predict IUD retention success, regardless of delivery mode.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not independently associated with successful retention of the IUD.
